tableQuery.query:
select
    t.statis_dt                                   as `统计日期`
	,t1.yyyyww                                    as `周`
	,t1.yyyymm                                    as `月`
	,t1.curr_quarter                              as `季`
	,t1.yyyy                                      as `年`
    ,t.store_code                                 as `门店编码`
	,t2.store_name                                as `门店名称`
	,t2.channel_brand_code                        as `渠道品牌编码`
	,t2.channel_brand                             as `渠道品牌`
	,t2.brand_large_area                          as `品牌大区`
	,t2.region                                    as `区域`
	,t2.store_categ_code                          as `店铺类型代码`
	,t2.store_categ_name                           as `店铺类型名称`
	,t2.store_type_dtl                            as `店铺类型明细`
	,t2.first_open_store_dt                       as `开业日期`
	,t2.close_store_dt                            as `闭店日期`
	,sum(t.bq_barg_amt)                           as `本期成交金额(GMV)`
    ,sum(t.bq_visitor_num)                        as `本期访客数(UV)`
    ,sum(t.bq_view_amt)                           as `本期浏览量(PV)`
    ,sum(t.bq_refund_amt)                         as `本期退款金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_barg_cnt)                           as `本期成交人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_old_cust_barg_cnt)                  as `本期老客成交人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_old_cust_barg_amt)                  as `本期老客成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_new_cust_barg_cnt)                  as `本期新客成交人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_new_cust_barg_amt)                  as `本期新客成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_barg_order_qty)                     as `本期成交订单数`
    ,sum(t.bq_barg_sub_order_qty)                 as `本期成交子订单数`
    ,sum(t.bq_barg_qty)                           as `本期成交数量`
    ,sum(t.bq_add_buy_cnt)                        as `本期加购人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_add_buy_piece)                      as `本期加购件数`
    ,sum(t.bq_good_coll_cnt)                      as `本期商品收藏人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_member_barg_amt)                    as `本期会员成交金额`
	,sum(t.bq_barg_amt)-sum(t.bq_member_barg_amt) as `本期非会员成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_member_barg_cnt)                    as `本期会员成交人数`
	,sum(t.bq_barg_cnt)-sum(t.bq_member_barg_cnt) as `本期非会员成交人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_member_reg_cnt)                     as `本期会员入会人数`
    ,sum(t.bq_pct)                                as `本期客单价`
    ,sum(t.bq_barg_conversion_ratio)              as `本期成交转化率`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_zy_live_pro_barg_amt)        as `本期抖音自营直播成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_zy_short_video_barg_amt)     as `本期抖音自营短视频成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_zy_good_card_barg_amt)       as `本期抖音自营商品卡成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_zy_pic_barg_amt)             as `本期抖音自营图文成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_zy_other_barg_amt)           as `本期抖音自营其他成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_co_live_pro_barg_amt)        as `本期抖音合作直播成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_co_short_video_barg_amt)     as `本期抖音合作短视频成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_co_good_card_barg_amt)       as `本期抖音合作商品卡成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_co_pic_barg_amt)             as `本期抖音合作图文成交金额`
    ,sum(t.bq_tiktok_co_other_barg_amt)           as `本期抖音合作其他成交金额`
	
	,sum(t.tq_barg_amt)                           as `同期成交金额(GMV)`
    ,sum(t.tq_visitor_num)                        as `同期访客数(UV)`
    ,sum(t.tq_view_amt)                           as `同期浏览量(PV)`
    ,sum(t.tq_refund_amt)                         as `同期退款金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_barg_cnt)                           as `同期成交人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_old_cust_barg_cnt)                  as `同期老客成交人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_old_cust_barg_amt)                  as `同期老客成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_new_cust_barg_cnt)                  as `同期新客成交人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_new_cust_barg_amt)                  as `同期新客成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_barg_order_qty)                     as `同期成交订单数`
    ,sum(t.tq_barg_sub_order_qty)                 as `同期成交子订单数`
    ,sum(t.tq_barg_qty)                           as `同期成交数量`
    ,sum(t.tq_add_buy_cnt)                        as `同期加购人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_add_buy_piece)                      as `同期加购件数`
    ,sum(t.tq_good_coll_cnt)                      as `同期商品收藏人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_member_barg_amt)                    as `同期会员成交金额`
	,sum(t.tq_barg_amt)-sum(t.tq_member_barg_amt) as `同期非会员成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_member_barg_cnt)                    as `同期会员成交人数`
	,sum(t.tq_barg_cnt)-sum(t.tq_member_barg_cnt) as `同期非会员成交人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_member_reg_cnt)                     as `同期会员入会人数`
    ,sum(t.tq_pct)                                as `同期客单价`
    ,sum(t.tq_barg_conversion_ratio)              as `同期成交转化率`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_zy_live_pro_barg_amt)        as `同期抖音自营直播成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_zy_short_video_barg_amt)     as `同期抖音自营短视频成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_zy_good_card_barg_amt)       as `同期抖音自营商品卡成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_zy_pic_barg_amt)             as `同期抖音自营图文成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_zy_other_barg_amt)           as `同期抖音自营其他成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_co_live_pro_barg_amt)        as `同期抖音合作直播成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_co_short_video_barg_amt)     as `同期抖音合作短视频成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_co_good_card_barg_amt)       as `同期抖音合作商品卡成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_co_pic_barg_amt)             as `同期抖音合作图文成交金额`
    ,sum(t.tq_tiktok_co_other_barg_amt)           as `同期抖音合作其他成交金额`
	,sum(t.bq_cw_ls_target)                       as `本期预算流水目标`
	,sum(t.bq_tz_ls_target)                       as `本期挑战目标`
	,ifnull(sum(t.bq_zk_ls_target),0)             as `本期吊牌目标`
	,sum(t.tq_cw_ls_target)                       as `同期预算流水目标`
	,sum(t.tq_tz_ls_target)                       as `同期挑战目标`
	,ifnull(sum(t.tq_zk_ls_target),0)             as `同期吊牌目标`
	,coalesce(t3.bq_mon_ls_target,0)              as `本期月预算流水目标`
	,coalesce(t3.bq_mon_tz_target,0)              as `本期月挑战目标`
	,coalesce(t4.tq_mon_ls_target,0)              as `同期月预算流水目标`
	,coalesce(t4.tq_mon_tz_target,0)              as `同期月挑战目标`
	,sum(t.bq_sale_qty)                           as `本期零售数量`
	,sum(t.bq_sale_amt)                           as `本期零售金额`
	,sum(t.bq_sale_tag_amt)                       as `本期零售吊牌金额`
	,sum(t.tq_sale_qty)                           as `同期零售数量`
	,sum(t.tq_sale_amt)                           as `同期零售金额`
	,sum(t.tq_sale_tag_amt)                       as `同期零售吊牌金额`
from (
    select
        statis_dt                               --统计日期

        ,tiktok_co_good_card_barg_amt        as bq_tiktok_co_good_card_barg_amt     --本期抖音合作商品卡成交金额
